title: Missing moeb tool: Read
description: Used Claude Code's native Read tool (Ã—3 calls) to read oversized tool result files written by the Claude Code MCP infrastructure to temp paths. No moeb equivalent exists. When a moeb tool response exceeds the MCP output size limit, Claude Code saves the result to a local temp file and the agent must use Read to access it. This creates a dependency on a non-moeb tool for every run where a moeb tool produces large output.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb tool capable of reading temp/arbitrary file paths (not only repo-relative paths), or investigate whether start_spec and start_run prompt sizes can be reduced sufficiently to avoid triggering MCP response overflow. A targeted read_output_file tool accepting an absolute path would eliminate the Read dependency.
resolution_summary: Superseded by consolidated signal a1000056: read_file and read_file_range cover in-project reads; absolute-path gap tracked separately.
